investment_theses.thesis: U.S. Treasury yields will re-test 2024 lows (sub-3.5%) by Q3 2026 as midterm election recession fears and geopolitical fragmentation drive safe-haven demand.
supporting_signals: CNBC survey: Americans nearly as gloomy about economy as post-pandemic emergence
Geopolitical escalation: Serbia election upset, Israel pivotal election, Venezuela opposition return, Middle East evacuations triggering crypto selloff
Airplanes scrapped years early—supply-chain stress signaling demand weakness
France protests over inequality/living costs across 410k participants—social pressure for fiscal stimulus, deflationary optics
investment_theses.counter_view: Tariff escalation (Audi defending $4B Georgia plant; Trump tariff rhetoric) reignites inflation fears, keeping yields elevated; Fed stays restrictive through midterms.
investment_theses.expression: Long TLT (iShares 20+ Year Treasury ETF) or short 10Y yield via TYX futures; hedge with long USD (DXY) on concurrent safe-haven bid.
